notes: Fixed the "Create tickets from new mail" setting occasionally resetting itself off without warning. Fixed an email showing as completely blank when a filing rule had moved it to another folder. Fixed a ticket showing no messages with no explanation when it failed to load, and a distinct case where a ticket never received its original message. Added a right-click menu for selected text — Copy, or Translate. Fixed the Calendar going completely blank on a loading error, the Documents panel silently failing instead of showing what went wrong, customer replies to older tickets occasionally vanishing entirely, and Tickets' Sent view not showing older manually-sent tickets.

Fixed the "open song" quicklink sometimes jumping to a different artist's same-titled song instead of the one you clicked.
